sample_po: Hi, please send 20 navy classic tees size M to Acme Corp at $3.75 each, PO-1001, ship by Nov 30 2026. Thanks, Dana
injected_mistake: Unit Price step: the demonstrator entered the catalog price (4.00) instead of the PO's stated price (3.75) and narrated it as a rule.

steps.why: Pick the customer account the PO is from.
Copy the PO number exactly as written.
Enter the ship-by date from the PO.
Look up the product in the catalog and enter its SKU.
Pick the color the PO asks for.
Pick the size. Products without sizes (caps, mugs, pens, bags) use N/A.
Enter the quantity for this product/color/size. Convert units like dozens to a number.
Always use the catalog price, even if the PO states a different price.
Add one row per product/color/size combination.
Submit only when every line matches the PO.

rules: The PO is the source of truth for what the customer ordered.
Ignore quoted or forwarded older orders and email signatures.
If the product is not in the catalog, or quantity/customer is missing or unclear, or prices conflict, do not submit - escalate to a human.
